description: Renew one of the USER'S OWN listings — reset its expiry to 30 days from now (native listings lapse ~30 days after posting). Free — no credit charge. Renewing an expired listing returns it to active; a pending, rejected, sold, or draft listing cannot be renewed.

listing_id.description: Listing id, taken from the `id` field of search_listings, semantic_search or list_my_listings results. Example: "adzuna-us-5947308680".
